column1: # Cash Shop catalogue. GENERATED by tools/cashshop/build_catalog.py -- do not edit by hand:
# change tools/cashshop/overrides.yaml (or the rules in catalog_rules.py), rebuild, lint.
# Sources: stock v83 Etc/Commodity.img on-sale rows, every other cash item with server WZ
# data (newer equips, pets, effects, weathers, chairs, mounts ...), then overrides.yaml.
# The ITEM ID is the key: one row per item, no serial numbers. Rows show in file order.
# itemId
# gender: 0 male / 1 female / 2 both, from the item id (the client's own rule).
# SERVICE rows: 5430000 (Extra Character Slot) and 9111000-9114000 (Equip/Use/Set-up/Etc +8
# slots, ids per Item.wz/Special/0911.img) are not delivered as items; buying one grants the
# slot directly (see CashShopServices). Storage +8 (9110000) is not sold: storage is already capped.
# Rate coupons (5211xxx EXP, 5360xxx drop) carry the stock Commodity.img periods; a period of 1
# on 5211048/5211060/5360042 means 4h/2h/4h. They are hidden while USE_SUPPLY_RATE_COUPONS is off.
# PENDING categories -- the window has no category for these yet, so they sit in an
# existing one (tools/cashshop/overrides.yaml pending_categories moves them):
#   chair      1877 rows  Chair (Set-up 301xxxx) -> now in 5/2 Game
#   mount        55 rows  Mount (190xxxx mounts, 191xxxx saddles) -> now in 5/6 Character
# STOCK on-sale commodities NOT sold (reason from the tool's rules or overrides.yaml):
#   Cash Shop Surprise: only opens inside the stock Cash Shop stage: 5222000
#   Etc/quest item, not Cash Shop merchandise: 4031063 4031180 4031191 4031192
#   Name Change / Transfer: only registered by the stock Cash Shop (0x2E): 5400000 5401000
#   Passed Gas / Floral Scent: no use handler (528): 5281000 5281001
#   Pet Snack: no use handler (546): 5460000
#   WZ cash flag is a string, not an int (treated as not cash): 1002950 1002951 1002952 1022037 1042141 1112916
# 10363 rows. itemId
